title.narrative: SUPPORT FOR AGRICULTURAL AND LIVESTOCK PRODUCTION

description.narrative: Lar Nova Esperanca (LNE) is a center that provides food, shelter and education for poor and homeless children and teenagers. It started in 1991, in response to the need to provide shelter to a small group of homeless boys. Since then it has grown in response to increasing needs in the area around which it started, in Matola. The LNE includes chicken farming and the production of eggs and part of the production will be to guarantee a healthy diet (meat and eggs) for the children of the LNE, but it will also sell part of the production to generate income that in the long term (one year) will support the LNE to continue production in the future.The goal of this project is to contribute to increase and improve production in the school farm by: 1. increase and improve livestock production in the Lar Nova Esperança:a) Improvement of the facilities;b) Improvement and handling of animals inclunding the purchase of pigs and laying hens with feed;c) increasing access to horticultural seeds and availability of improved seeds;d) increasing the production of compost and its use in internal production.2. Improve the existing equipment in the carpentry workshop for youth training.
